name: Smart Comment Convertor
author: Sadhan Pal

sections.description:
Smart Comment Convertor transforms your WordPress comments into an elegant FAQ section. The plugin automatically:

  • Detects questions in comments (looking for question marks and question words)
  • Displays questions in large, bold text for better visibility
  • Shows complete comment content as the answer
  • Creates interactive toggle functionality
  • Preserves comment author and date information

Features:

  • Automatic question detection from comments
  • Beautiful accordion-style FAQ display
  • Customizable FAQ section title
  • Option to show only approved comments
  • Shortcode support for manual placement
  • Responsive design works on all devices
  • Lightweight and fast

Additional Information

For support, please visit Blogging Foundation
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the plugin from WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure settings under Settings > Comment to FAQ
  4. The FAQs will automatically appear below your post content
sections.faq:
How does the plugin detect questions?

The plugin looks for sentences containing question marks (?). If none are found, it uses the first sentence of the comment.

Can I customize the FAQ appearance?

Yes! You can change the FAQ title and choose whether to display only approved comments in the settings.

How can I manually place the FAQs?

Use the shortcode [smarcoco_faqs] anywhere in your content.

Can I use this with any post type?

Yes, the plugin works with any post type that supports comments.
